name: 50627 · Eldora, IA
findings: ZIP 50627 (Eldora) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 50627 (Eldora) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 50627 (Eldora) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
